chapters.title: Start from Scratch
chapters.objective: Ask around Lumbridge, see if anyone has heard of battling their pets.

intro.speaker: hans
intro.text: Hello. Lovely day for it. Don't mind me - I'm only doing my rounds. Been doing them a while now.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Have you seen anyone battling their pets?

intro.speaker: hans
intro.text: It's quite new from what I've heard. Lots of talk about it lately, though I don't partake myself.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Know anyone willing to battle?

intro.speaker: hans
intro.text: I've heard there's a tinkerer out west. They say he battles trainers clear across the realm without ever leaving his chair.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I'll go check it out, thanks!

chapters.title: The Absent-Minded Inventor
chapters.objective: Seek out the reclusive inventor west of Lumbridge.

intro.speaker: professor_oddenstein
intro.text: Careful in here, there's a lot of dangerous equipment about. And don't touch the big lever. Or do, I suppose. It's your afternoon.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I'm looking for whoever's been battling trainers from inside a tower.

intro.speaker: professor_oddenstein
intro.text: Ah! That'll be me. And that'll be this - my Remote Battle Device. Finest work I've ever done.

choice.label: So why do you look so glum?

lines.speaker: professor_oddenstein
lines.text: Because I keep losing, that's why. Marvellous machine. Hopeless operator.

lines.speaker: professor_oddenstein
lines.text: Fifty-one bouts. I've won two, and one of those was because the other fellow's cat fell asleep.

lines.speaker: professor_oddenstein
lines.text: Umm... define wrong.

lines.speaker: professor_oddenstein
lines.text: It has never once misfired. Try telling the village that. They've decided anything they can't explain must be the man in the tower with the machine.

choice.label: Could I have a go with it?

lines.speaker: professor_oddenstein
lines.text: Perhaps. Perhaps! If you can prove you know one end of a pet battle from the other.

intro.speaker: professor_oddenstein
intro.text: Humour an old man - a quick bout, right here, you and me. Do try not to knock the pressure gauge.

rewardConversation.speaker: professor_oddenstein
rewardConversation.text: Splendid! Far better than I ever manage. Here, you have it. The Device, I mean. I'm retiring from the field.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: I couldn't possibly-

rewardConversation.speaker: professor_oddenstein
rewardConversation.text: Nonsense, you'd be doing me a kindness. I'd only keep losing with it. Oh - one thing. Small thing.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: There's always a small thing.

rewardConversation.speaker: professor_oddenstein
rewardConversation.text: It can only reach a trainer it's already met. You beat them in person the once, it learns them, and after that you can call on them from anywhere. A calibration, if you like.

rewardConversation.speaker: professor_oddenstein
rewardConversation.text: Oh. And since you'll hear it in the village anyway: pets have been going missing.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: And they think it's the Device.

rewardConversation.speaker: professor_oddenstein
rewardConversation.text: A machine that reaches clear across the realm? Of course they do. I'd think it myself, if it weren't mine.

rewardConversation.speaker: professor_oddenstein
rewardConversation.text: I'm not asking you to do anything about it, mind. I'm only saying you'll be carrying my machine about now, and people do draw their own conclusions.

intro.text: Pets are vanishing across Gielinor - and whatever is behind it, it isn't the professor.

chapters.title: Draynor Village
chapters.objective: I should ask the people Draynor if they've seen anything unusual.

intro.speaker: draynor_guard
intro.text: Watch yourself! Fresh paint over here!!

choice.label: That mortar looks new, recently rebuilt?

lines.speaker: draynor_guard
lines.text: What's it to you, adventurer?

choice.label: Has anyone lost any pets around here?

lines.speaker: draynor_guard
lines.text: Nothing was taken out of that vault. Not one pet. Not on my watch!

choice.label: Who takes over when you're not here?

intro.speaker: draynor_guard
intro.text: Right, that's enough questions from you. If you won't shove off, we'll settle it the hard way!

rewardConversation.speaker: draynor_guard
rewardConversation.text: Beat me fair, I'll give you that.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: What's really happening around here?

rewardConversation.speaker: draynor_guard
rewardConversation.text: Every night something strange happens, I wake in my own bed with no memory of how I got there.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: Pets are vanishing all over Gielinor, and the rumors are it's Oddenstein.

rewardConversation.speaker: draynor_guard
rewardConversation.text: Listen, all I know is that every one of them comes home! Probita insures the lot, free of charge. No harm done, so there's nothing to report.

chapters.title: Insurance Lead
chapters.objective: The guard mentioned Probita insures every pet, somewhere in East Ardougne.

intro.speaker: probita
intro.text: Welcome to the pet insurance bureau. How can I help you?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I'm asking about stolen pets.

intro.speaker: probita
intro.text: A stolen companion? That's rediculous, you can't theive pets! Anyway, every pet is insured the moment you find it, automatically, and reclaiming one costs you nothing at all. Free!

choice.label: Free? Who pays for it, then?

lines.speaker: probita
lines.text: The service is subsidised by the Crown, through Ardougne's taxes.

lines.speaker: probita
lines.text: Abuse it? Goodness. I don't think anyone's ever tried.

choice.label: How many have you handed back?

lines.speaker: probita
lines.text: This month? Let's have a look... ooh. More than last month!

lines.speaker: probita
lines.text: Looking at the records, it's the same few names bringing them in. Very civic-minded of them, don't you think?

lines.speaker: probita
lines.text: Of course! Do come back if you lose anything. Or find anything!

chapters.title: Rogues' Errand
chapters.objective: A scheme like this needs a master thief. The Rogues' Den would know their own.

intro.speaker: martin_thwait
intro.text: What do you want?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I'm looking for whoever's stealing people's pets!

intro.speaker: martin_thwait
intro.text: And you're looking for a snitch? Go pound sand.

choice.label: I want to understand how it works

lines.speaker: martin_thwait
lines.text: It's obvious isn't it? Nothing's stolen if it all comes home.

lines.speaker: martin_thwait
lines.text: You're not accusing me, are you? You're further from finding this out than I thought!

choice.label: Fine. Let's do this your way.

lines.speaker: martin_thwait
lines.text: That's the spirit. Nothing personal, mate.

rewardConversation.speaker: martin_thwait
rewardConversation.text: ...Not bad. Not bad at all. Alright, you've earned a straight answer, and I don't hand many of those out.

rewardConversation.speaker: martin_thwait
rewardConversation.text: They're stealing the pets out of the banks and using the recovery system for the finders fee. A fee subsidised by the Crown. Ledger balances. No "crime".

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: So you think someone is cooking the Crown's books?

rewardConversation.speaker: martin_thwait
rewardConversation.text: Now you're thinking. That coin doesn't come out of a purse under a counter, mate - it comes off the Crown's subsidy ledger. Someone inside Ardougne has to be signing that line.

rewardConversation.speaker: martin_thwait
rewardConversation.text: Here, take this - it might help you with what lies ahead.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I regret to inform you that you've been found out! Only someone with access to the banks AND the ledger would be able to steal pets right from under people's noses!

intro.speaker: king_of_ardougne
intro.text: I'm sorry, what are you talking about?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: The jig is up old man! You've been caught!

intro.speaker: king_of_ardougne
intro.text: I think you must be confused. I'm only the face of the kingdom, I do not bother myself with the financial matters.

lines.speaker: king_of_ardougne
lines.text: My accountant. Ambassador Gimblewap - a gnome with a monocle and a talent for small print. If coin went astray, it went astray through him.

choice.label: I'm sorry, I better get going...

chapters.title: The Ambassador's Ledger
chapters.objective: The King's books belong to Ambassador Gimblewap. Find the gnome bookkeeper.

intro.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
intro.text: Looking for something?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You. The mastermind behind it all!

intro.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
intro.text: Oh you must be the adventurer that accused the king of pet theft. Not the brightest one I presume.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Those sound like fighting words...

intro.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
intro.text: HA! Very well. Let it never be said a gnome refused a challenge.

rewardConversation.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
rewardConversation.text: Fine. FINE. I adjusted a subsidy line. One line. It was beautifully done and nobody was ever going to notice.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: You cooked a kingdom's books.

rewardConversation.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
rewardConversation.text: I balanced a kingdom's books. There is a difference and it is precisely one column wide.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: Who told you to do it?

rewardConversation.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
rewardConversation.text: I have no idea! Do you imagine I asked? The instructions arrived sealed, the payment arrived sealed, and I am not paid to be curious.

rewardConversation.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
rewardConversation.text: Take the wretched thing if you don't believe me. Every letter he ever sent. Same elegant old hand, same ridiculous signature.

rewardConversation.speaker: ambassador_gimblewap
rewardConversation.text: Now go away. I have a column to re-balance.

chapters.title: Full Circle
chapters.objective: The envelope reveals a signature: 'White Beard.' That isn't a name, it's a description - and only one person links back to Draynor.

intro.speaker: wise_old_man
intro.text: Ah. There you are. Do come in and sit down, you've had a long walk of it. ...No? Standing, then. As you like.

choice.label: It was you the whole time.

lines.speaker: wise_old_man
lines.text: Guilty, and rather proud, if I'm honest. Who else knows this bank's every brick? I took the place apart once before, you know, back when I was young enough to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: wise_old_man
lines.text: A pension, dear friend. They don't stretch the way they used to.

lines.speaker: wise_old_man
lines.text: I only wanted a better kettle. Then the kettle wanted a new stove, and the stove wanted a new hearth, and by then I had rather a good system running and it seemed a waste to stop.

lines.speaker: wise_old_man
lines.text: Because a thing done well ought to be signed. And because I was curious how long it would take somebody clever to come and ask me that.

lines.speaker: wise_old_man
lines.text: I have been retired a very long time. Nobody has asked me anything interesting in most of it.

intro.speaker: wise_old_man
intro.text: One last game. For old times' sake. Do try to make it interesting.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Ha! Beaten fair and square - marvellous. It has been a very long time since anybody managed that.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: You stole them to sell them back to their own insurance.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Stole is a strong word, dear friend. Every pet came home. Nobody ended up a copper poorer, and the Crown has more coin than it knows what to do with.

rewardConversation.speaker: player
rewardConversation.text: Except the professor. A harmless old man, and you let the whole village turn on him.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Ah.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Yes. That was the clever part, and I shan't pretend it was an accident. A machine that reaches clear across the realm, appearing the very season pets began to wander off? I never had to say a word. I only had to let people finish the thought themselves.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: ...When you put it quite so plainly it does sound rather bad, doesn't it.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Oh, very well. I shall repay the Crown, write to the village about the professor, and hang up the lockpicks. Again.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Here. Take this - I lifted it from a party in Falador a very long time ago, when I was quicker and a good deal worse at it. It's the only thing I ever took that I couldn't bring myself to give back.

rewardConversation.speaker: wise_old_man
rewardConversation.text: Wear it better than I did.
